skills.name: Bofurin Kiss
skills.description: Headbutts enemies.  *Cancels enemy buffs  *Negates enemies' regen (10 sec) *HP x 1000% Area Damage

skills.name: Bofurin Garden
skills.description: Happily tends to home garden.  Good effects on allies.  *HP +400% (7 sec) *HP x 70% Area Recovery (per sec) (7 sec) *Skill Resistance +60% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: WIND BREAKER
abilities.description: WIND BREAKER Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle.  You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy Silence: Agility
abilities.description: Has a high chance of making all Agility type enemies' Skills unusable and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
